properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank maintains an Operational Risk Policy to identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks that could impact customers, staff, or business continuity.

properties.risk_definition: Risks including process failures, systems outages, fraud, and compliance breaches that could impact customers, staff, or business continuity.

properties.core_policy_statement: To establish procedures for operational risk management that identify operational risks proactively, assess risk impact and likelihood, implement mitigation controls, monitor risk metrics, and report to senior management and Board.

Reporting of Operational Risk to Senior Management and Board
